name: PORTAL RAKYAT
tagline: A Malaysian government services portal that citizens trust

brief.name: Portal Rakyat
brief.industry: Malaysian federal government digital-services portal — renew licences, pay assessment (cukai), book appointments, check applications
brief.audience: Malaysian citizens of all ages and digital literacy levels; must work for an uncle on an old Android as well as a student on a laptop. Bilingual BM + English.
brief.tone: trustworthy, calm, official-but-human, clear, respectful, accessible
brief.references: MyGov / MySejahtera, GovTech-style civic design, PETRONAS and Maybank for institutional trust
brief.context: Bilingual: Bahasa Melayu primary with an EN toggle. 'Selamat Datang' hero with a prominent service search and the top 6 e-services as large tiles. Clear status-check flow, FAQ, and a contact/help footer with official seals. Islamic geometric pattern as a slim, restrained header band only. WCAG AA, large touch targets, works on low-end devices.
brief.avoid: Figurative or religious imagery as decoration. Songket as full-bleed wallpaper. Marketing tone or hype. Tiny touch targets. English-only. Trend-driven design that undercuts institutional trust.
